intake.matter_summary: Third-degree DWI charge and parallel implied-consent license revocation following a Highway 10 stop in Sherburne County; commercial-license holder whose CDL and livelihood are at risk, with a prior offense driving the degree of the charge. Client seeks to challenge the stop and the breath test and to protect his driving privileges.

conflicts_check.notes: No current or former client is adverse to Travis Wenzloff. The arresting deputy, the employer, the tap house, and the reporting motorist present no conflict. New flat-fee client referred by his employer's business counsel; the employer is not a party and is not represented in this matter.

time_entries.narrative: Initial intake interview with Travis Wenzloff; assessed third-degree DWI charge, 0.09 breath reading, prior-offense exposure, and commercial-license consequences.
Reviewed incident report, breath-test record, and implied-consent advisory; opened matter file and calendared the implied-consent judicial-review deadline and criminal dates.
Drafted and filed timely petition for judicial review of the implied-consent license revocation; served notice on the parties.
Appeared at first criminal appearance; entered not-guilty plea; requested a contested omnibus hearing.
Drafted and served demand for discovery, including squad dashcam, body-worn camera, 911 audio and CAD log, and DataMaster maintenance and observation records.
Reviewed dashcam and bodycam footage; analyzed the follow, the single fog-line contact, and field-sobriety administration on the icy shoulder in extreme cold.
Legal research and analysis of breath-test mouth-alcohol and margin-of-error issues and the observation-period record; developed suppression theory and identified potential defense expert.
Follow-up client meeting; obtained pharmacy records and medical authorization on the reflux condition and the alcohol-based cough preparation; documented mouthwash use.
Prepared negotiation position centered on protecting the commercial license; opened plea discussions with the assistant county attorney.
Outlined omnibus suppression arguments on the stop and the breath test and the implied-consent review issues; prepared client for the contested hearing.
Reviewed status ahead of pending omnibus and implied-consent hearings; updated client on options and the two parallel proceedings.
